description: The per-document agent-assignment layer (D-571, D-572, D-575; scripts/agent_assignment.py). Python reads each document's STRUCTURAL conditions (no meaning, no keyword table: WORDS-A) and assigns the production agents the document needs. Every assignment and every skip is recorded with its reason (audit/agent_assignment.json and agent_activation's not_called, state unassigned). A skip is made only by a rule listed in skip_rules, each naming the built rule it rests on; with none listed every agent is assigned, as before the layer. One is shipped (D-652): SPEECH_ACT_TAGGER is not run on a document of tables alone. The floor is the set of compositions the rules make mandatory; an assignment below it is refused before any call. The floor is data, so a rule change (for example INFRA-053's reading of LAW-III) is written here, never in code.

skip_rules.note: SPEECH_ACT_TAGGER tags what a running sentence does; a document of tables, their captions and label: value lines carries no running sentence, so the agent has nothing to work on and is not run (its tags are audit-only and decide no item). Not a floor agent (F1 to F7). The integrity rule (one bad reply voids an entry) is unchanged: the agent is not run, its reply is not forgiven.

skip_rule_form: {"agent": NAME, "when": {CONDITION: VALUE, ...} (every listed condition equal), "rule": the built rule it rests on, "note": why}

floor.text: A produced draft is audited by the other model family: VERIFIER (local_auditor) on PROCESSOR's (local_producer) draft wherever PROCESSOR runs.
floor.enforced_by: the backend column fixed in code (pipeline, the agent table), gate checks 87 and 127

floor.text: PROCESSOR runs on checkpoint 168 for every document under review.
INST_FINDER runs unless an operator-ratified amendment switches it off; the switch, not this layer, decides that.
The redaction phase always runs, with its hard stop when no rule compiles. Not an agent assignment: listed so the floor is whole.
The verifiability gate always runs. Not an agent assignment.
An editorial observation is reviewed by the other family, or recorded as not reviewed. Not a production assignment.
An agent's function is never done by another: a skip rule may skip an agent, never route its work to another.
floor.enforced_by: the registry; agent_assignment refuses a skip rule that names a replacement
